title: ggsegYeo2011 2.0.0
text: yeo7 yeo17 now ggseg_atlas objects (ggseg.formats) containing 2D 3D data. separate yeo7_3d yeo17_3d objects removed. Use ggplot() + ggseg::geom_brain(atlas = yeo7) 2D plots ggseg3d::ggseg3d(atlas = yeo7) 3D plots — object. ggseg.formats now hard dependency (Depends). Package URLs updated LCBC-UiO ggseg GitHub organisation.
